case.question: What are some relaxing outdoor activities I could do around sunset that don’t require much equipment?
case.gold_answer: As the sun dips behind the ranges, you might settle into a quiet spot on the porch or out by the paddock fence, letting the soft light catch the wings of tui and kererū drifting home. A pair of binoculars and a keen ear are enough to turn those moments into a kind of moving poetry, one you simply watch unfold.
